newsitem.title: UK: UK's Biocompatibles buys Germany's Urotech.
newsitem.headline: UK's Biocompatibles buys Germany's Urotech.

text.p: Britain's Biocompatibles International Plc said on Wednesday it would buy Germany's Urotech Medizinische Technologie GmbH and its manufacturing company Endo Produktiongesellschaft fuer Medical- und Laborprodukte mbH.
Biocompatibles said it would pay for the acquisitions with new Biocompatibles shares valued at around 5.5 million stg.
It said 4.6 million stg of that would be issued immediately and the remaining shares issued over the next three years.
Biocompatibles said Urotech makes and sells urological and surgical devices and is number three in the German urological devices market.
